nom: Eucerin Anti-Age Hyaluron-Filler 10% Pure Vitamin C

avis.texte: Freshly activated vitamin C? Wow. This is a fantastic product. Unlike other sticky serums, this has Eucerin's trademark hyaluronic formulation (which penetrates and moisturises better than most brands) so your skin feels soft and creamy upon application. Because you have to shake then pump to mix and activate the vitamin C it actually works without becoming oxidized.

I bought 2 boxes as such a good price but they were both close to date July 21 which was fine but I buy this serum regularly and it is usually a cream milk colour and these were more orange brown. When I looked it up it seems that the vit c has been oxidised which makes it less effective as an ingredient. I tried contacting the seller but didn’t get a reply.

avis.titre: Great Value for High Quality Serum
avis.texte: *Be careful to know who you're ordering from as there are cheaper fake products out there. I verified that this is an authorized vender before ordering. I added these to my Cerave daily skin care regimen after a dermatologist mentioned it on Youtube, and I'm very happy. Hard to know what the results are as I use a good program anyway. But I can say that each tube lasts longer than I expected, over 2 weeks. I could probably make it last 3 weeks per tube with careful dispensing. So if you want to add Vitamin C Serum to your skincare program, this one matches the quality of much more expensive brands according to several dermatologists.
Second time i bought this as i add Vitamin C booster to my skin care routine. I'm happy with the result, i really recomend it.
